supports.claim: A modification is not done until a named capability battery reruns green, and the verification stage is copied even when the modification itself is rejected; OBLITERATUS proves the discipline in someone else's forge (EXCISE then VERIFY capability retention before REBIRTH/save).
supports.reason: Quote states the verification stage (capability retention check) "is the part to copy regardless of whether we adopt the ablation" (= copied even when the modification is rejected) and "verify-after-modify with a named battery is our own gate discipline, proven in someone else's forge" (= named-battery gate; a gate discipline entails the modification is not done until the battery passes; proven in someone else's forge). Every substantive conjunct of the claim is entailed; the EXCISE/REBIRTH stage names are parenthetical elaboration of the same discipline the quote identifies via "capability retention check" and "the ablation".

supports.claim: After excising a behavior at one layer, keep a detector watching for its re-emergence downstream; a fix that can be silently re-encoded is displaced, not closed, and the detector is the measurement that tells the difference.
supports.reason: Quote is the directive itself: "their module is the measurement shape to steal: excise a behavior at one layer, detect its re-emergence downstream" — entails the downstream re-emergence detector and the detector-as-measurement framing. Prescribing a detector for downstream re-emergence entails the excised behavior can re-emerge (be re-encoded) elsewhere, i.e. the fix is displaced rather than closed.

supports.claim: Tools report their own failures inside the result object so the caller can branch; conditional composition is possible because failure arrives as data the next turn can read, not as transport death, and protocol-level errors carry no recovery path.
supports.reason: Quote: "the agent can branch on failure because failure arrives as data, not as transport death" — entails failure delivered as readable data enabling the caller/agent to branch (conditional composition), and by contrast that transport-level (protocol) failure is "death", i.e. carries no recovery path.

supports.claim: A fan-in payload ref is a replay descriptor carrying the original tool name plus arguments, not cached server state, so N prior calls merge into one consumer with no shared session and the chain stays stable across schema drift in surrounding fields.
supports.reason: Quote covers "refs are portable because they are serialized call parameters" (= replay descriptor of name+args, not cached server state) and "fan-in is N prior calls merged into 1 consumer without any shared session state". But the claim's conjunct "the chain stays stable across schema drift in surrounding fields" has no footing in the quote — the quote never mentions schema drift or chain stability — so the quote does not entail the full claim.

supports.claim: Authorization is a ring gradient (ring 0 stdio spawn-is-trust, ring 1 LAN shared key constant-time compare, ring 2 internet per-seat tokens) and a mutating call executes only inside a broker authority envelope; prompt text proposes, only switchboard-issued authority executes, and provider keys never cross.
supports.reason: Quote entails only the propose/execute split: "an external agent's PROMPT can propose a bank; only an authority object issued through the switchboard executes it". The claim's ring-gradient conjunct (ring 0 stdio spawn-is-trust, ring 1 LAN shared key constant-time compare, ring 2 internet per-seat tokens) and the "provider keys never cross" clause appear nowhere in the quote, so it does not entail the full claim.
